scope: CM-02 diagnostic-only TypeRef rendering resource boundary

grf.observed_anchor: Merged CM-02 alias-DAG structural sharing bounds canonicalization/equality by distinct structural work, but the prior diagnostic renderer expanded every occurrence path.
grf.generated_hypothesis: Diagnostic rendering is an independent resource surface and requires its own explicit output budget even when TypeRef structure is shared.
grf.strongest_counterhypothesis: Structural sharing alone is sufficient; an additional render budget would only reduce compatibility and add complexity.
grf.discriminator: Render a compact maximally shared binary TypeRef DAG through the exact production renderer and measure expanded output, time and allocation.
grf.collapse: Counterhypothesis refuted. A tiny DAG can expand into very large diagnostic text. Preserve ordinary/deep accepted diagnostics while bounding pathological occurrence-tree expansion.

unusual_experiment.shape: leaf I; each level P(child, child) reuses the same immutable child object twice

implementation.mechanism: Perform an exact bounded preflight of expanded diagnostic character cost without materializing output. Preserve the existing byte-identical Name<A, B> rendering when within budget; return an explicit incomplete marker when above budget.

negative_evidence.cause: The unchanged production-totality contract requires the depth-4096 unary TypeRef diagnostic to remain complete; that accepted output is 20,483 characters and was incorrectly bounded by the initial 16 KiB candidate.
negative_evidence.response: Raise the diagnostic-only budget to 32,768 rather than weakening the existing contract.

negative_evidence.semantic_checks: 11/12 checks passed; deep diagnostic rendering passed with length 20,483
negative_evidence.interpretation: Host-contention candidate; absolute deep runtime remained far below the 5 s guard.
One same-job replication separated timing noise from semantic/resource regression; no further unusual experiment was performed.

promotion.remaining_cm02_scope: Broader type/effect semantics required for Clay Machine I/O, process/network and buffer semantics remain open.
